selection_rule: Highest pooled repeated development CV accuracy, then highest worst-fold accuracy, then fewer features; remaining ties prefer linear, LDA, RBF, lower C, the default gamma, and stable profile order.

search.prediction_count_note: Each development clip is evaluated once per partition. The repeated prediction denominator is not a count of independent audio clips.

split_protocol.description: Latest ceil(20%) per key held out chronologically; one preceding clip per key purged. Development validation repeats contiguous 3-, 4-, and 5-fold partitions per key, each with one adjacent clip on both sides purged from training.

limitations: Each key has one source recording. Recording identity is confounded with the key label.
Chronological held-out clips measure later presses within the same recordings; they do not measure generalization to a new recording session, phone, keyboard, or environment.
The final keypress_model.joblib is refitted on all clips, including the evaluation holdout. Use evaluation_model.joblib to reproduce held-out predictions.
Classifier decision scores are ranking scores, not calibrated probabilities.
Repeated CV reuses development clips across three partitions. Its prediction count is not a count of independent recordings or unique clips.
